      public Recommendation(String wellName, StrupeOkeReport.Action action, double currentChokeFraction, double recommendedChokeFraction, double recommendedLiftRate, double currentOil, double optimizedOil, double expectedUplift, String bindingConstraint, String lockReason)

      Parameters:
      wellName - well name

      lockReason - operational lock reason (may be empty)
